notes.title: Progress Map Update
notes.content:
The Traveler's Agency is investing on planet research, so from now on every Traveller can keep track of his progress, journey after journey you will discover the history behind every piece.
You can find the progress map on main menu, inside of it you can move between pieces locations, you will discover how everything is connected.

notes.title: Journey To Planet Earth Released
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!
As someone posted on an early version of the game it is filled with passion, love and BUGS!
So, you can expect your journey to be tricky or not, it depends on your playstyle....
Menu is written in English but all the in-game texts are written in Italian, as the game is located in Italy most of the written things are site-specific.

The game will receive updates, from gameplay to storyline, write down the most annoying bugs you find during your journey and i will do my best to get it done!

If you want to support development you can make a donation trough the itch.io page of the game.

Good Luck Travelers!
